Banner.Description: I am a Generative AI Engineer with hands-on experience building LLM applications, RAG pipelines, and agentic AI systems using Python, LangGraph, LangChain, Google ADK, and FastAPI. My work spans document ingestion, retrieval architectures, prompt engineering, tool calling, and multi-agent orchestration—delivering modular solutions that are both technically robust and aligned with business goals.
AboutMe.Title: About me
AboutMe.Paragraphs: I build practical LLM applications, RAG pipelines, and agentic AI systems using Python, LangGraph, LangChain, Google ADK, and FastAPI. My focus covers document ingestion, retrieval architectures, prompt engineering, tool calling, and multi-agent orchestration. I contributed to Deloitte’s AI Tax Assistant by developing RAG and document-processing workflows over thousands of proprietary legal documents, and built multi-tenant conversational AI systems for customer-specific use cases. I am a U.S. Permanent Resident with a WES-verified U.S. bachelor’s-equivalent degree in Information Technology Engineering.

Experience.Title: Experience

Experience.Jobs.Title: Gen AI Engineer
Description: Contributed to the development and deployment of Deloitte’s AI Tax Assistant, implementing RAG, LangChain, LangGraph, and prompt engineering to ingest, index, and retrieve information from thousands of proprietary legal documents for MENA tax guidance.

Built AI4ALL, a multi-tenant AI platform for rapidly deploying and demonstrating customer-specific AI agents and prototypes, using Python, Google ADK, agent orchestration, tool calling, and prompt engineering; reduced the time required to deliver new AI prototypes from days or weeks to hours.

Developed Luna, a conversational AI financial assistant, leveraging RAG, prompt engineering (Few-Shot, ReAct), and context-injection to deliver safe, personalized answers to financial inquiries, reducing routine customer support tickets by 60%.

Experience.Jobs.Title: Software Developer
Description: Developed and maintained production web applications using Angular, Laravel, and REST APIs.
Built reusable UI components and integrated backend services to support feature delivery.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Deloitte's AI Tax Assistant
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: Deloitte's AI Tax Assistant is a specialized RAG system for MENA tax guidance—ingesting, indexing, and retrieving information from thousands of proprietary legal documents with LangChain, LangGraph, and prompt engineering for high-fidelity answers and document summaries.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: MALY's Luna
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: Luna is a conversational AI financial assistant that uses RAG, Few-Shot and ReAct prompting, and context-injection to deliver safe, personalized answers—reducing routine customer support tickets by 60%.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: AI4ALL
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: AI4ALL is a multi-tenant AI platform for rapidly deploying and demonstrating customer-specific AI agents and prototypes with Google ADK, agent orchestration, and tool calling—cutting new prototype delivery from days or weeks to hours.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: MALY's data ingestion pipeline
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: Ingestion pipeline automates parsing, chunking, and vectorization of diverse document formats for AI assistant knowledge bases—forming the core of Maly’s RAG architecture for consistent, efficient retrieval across applications.

OtherProjects.Title: More personal projects

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Multi-Agent Travel Planner
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: LangChain and LangGraph multi-agent travel planner that orchestrates specialized agents and dynamically provisions destination-specific RAG knowledge bases when information is unavailable from the indexed knowledge base.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Document Processing Service
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: Multi-tenant data ingestion service for RAG systems that automates parsing and vectorization of PDFs, DOCX, PPTX, TXT, and MD using Docling, LlamaParse, and Jina’s late chunking—accelerating the creation of new agentic RAG applications.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Fruitful Tree Count Management
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: Full-stack farm management system uses Computer Vision, specifically low-cost spectral signature recognition on satellite images, for automated fruit tree counting, change detection using Google Earth Engine and comprehensive farm management services.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: LangGraph Agent — Clean Architecture
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: Demonstrates how to ship a serious agent backend: orchestration with LangChain and LangGraph, real auth and persistence, optional background jobs, and MCP for external tools—structured so teams can extend modules without rewriting the core.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Academic AI Projects
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: Applied NLP, computer-vision, deep-learning, and machine-learning projects (2021–2024), including hand-gesture recognition, text classification, and income prediction using OpenCV, Scikit-learn, and PyTorch.
